title: Controlled Retrieval-augmented Context Evaluation for Long-form RAG
reasoning: The paper introduces the CRUX evaluation framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It uses human-written news summaries for its datasets. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics; keywords like 'morals' only appear in the content of specific news examples used for testing retrieval coverage.
